finalProse.chartStory: Support has already failed, but buyers are trying to stabilise MSFT after that breakdown. The chart is still damaged, and the rebound still needs to prove itself.
finalProse.whyItMatters: When support breaks first, a rebound is only the start of a repair attempt, not proof that the chart damage is repaired.
finalProse.setupLocation: Price is sitting below the support it lost, so the chart still needs repair and a reclaim of that area.
finalProse.learningPoint: A damaged chart can bounce before it is fixed. Traders still need to see buyers build a base and reclaim lost support before trusting it.
finalProse.whatNext: Watch for proof through a firmer base, stronger closes, and a reclaim of lost support before treating the rebound as meaningful.
